Definition: third person singular present of a compound of G1722 and G1209; (impersonally) it is accepted in, i.e. admitted (possible):--can (+ not) be.
BiblicalUsage: Jesus says it cannot be that a prophet perish out of Jerusalem in Luke 13:33 — He must walk today and tomorrow and the day following, because Jerusalem is where prophets die.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jesus walked toward Jerusalem knowing exactly what waited there, and that steady courage is what I want when my own road turns hard.
